newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coolgardie, Pasminco end j/v talks.
newsitem.headline: Coolgardie, Pasminco end j/v talks.

text.p: Coolgardie Gold NL said on Thursday that Pasminco Ltd would not proceed with an investment in the Riversleigh base metals project north of Mount Isa in northwestern Queensland.
Coolgardie said the talks ended by mutual agreement and followed Pasminco's acquisition of the Century zinc project.
The company also said it might consider Riversleigh joint venture proposals already made by other major companies.
The two companies said on October 10 last year that Pasminco would earn a 75 percent stake in the project by spending A$10 million over six years.
